title: AIAS Engineering Intelligence Core
purpose: Produce bounded engineering recommendations from verified evidence with deterministic confidence, conflict detection and abstention.
scope: Requests, evidence identity, trust, claim coverage, risk thresholds, conflicts, recommendations, abstention, audit records, AEKS execution, differential validation and EKG context.

requirements.title: Evidence contract
requirements.statement: Every fact shall have identity, source, claim, value, trust, digest and legal status.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Deterministic confidence
requirements.statement: Confidence shall derive from required-claim coverage, evidence trust, conflicts and risk threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Mandatory abstention
requirements.statement: The core shall abstain when claims are missing, contradictory or below the risk threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Auditability
requirements.statement: Every outcome shall retain evidence identifiers, reasons, assessment and record digest.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: A real AEKS calculation shall be checked by differential validation and EKG context before recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Intelligence core shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
